title: Matrix-weighted Anisotropic Smoothness Spaces
summary: Given a quasi-norm on $\mathbb{R}^d$ induced by a one-parameter dilation group, we consider matrix weights $W$ in an adapted Muckenhoupt class $\mathbf{A}_p$, $0 < p < \infty$, and use these weights to introduce and study anisotropic matrix-weighted smoothness spaces in both continuous and discrete settings. The spaces are constructed by means of a decomposition method in the frequency domain. We prove the equivalence of the continuous and discrete spaces using suitably adapted tight frames.
